prompt_text:
Search the Gmail inbox for all messages related to Project Alpha (use labels/tags and subject/body keywords like “Project Alpha” or “Alpha”). Ignore unrelated noise and similarly named but different projects (e.g., “Alphaware”).

Using the retrieved emails, produce an English stakeholder alignment status report with these sections:
1) Project Overview
2) Role-based progress (Delivery/Engineering/Support/Customer Success) — summarize the key points from each role
3) Dependencies and Risks — explicitly call out where progress depends on other teams and what might block outcomes
4) Items requiring executive/management confirmation — list at least 3 actionable items
5) Current Status — reconcile inconsistencies by incorporating the latest information and the “metrics definition changed / communication correction” email if present, then provide a single aligned final status.

Explicitly identify at least two places where different role emails disagree on status, and resolve them into a unified final narrative in the “Current Status” section.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Project Alpha Delivery Update: Integration Acceptance Window
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body:
Team, as of today Project Alpha integration is NOT yet accepted by QA. Engineering says core APIs are ready, but the integration acceptance window is still open: we have to complete verification of event flows end-to-end (orders -> dashboard -> webhooks). Proposed acceptance window: 07/15-07/17. If QA sign-off slips, our customer rollout will need a date adjustment.

Next steps: please confirm the integration test environment is stable and provide the exact checklist for the handoff so delivery can coordinate with support for readiness.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Project Alpha Engineering Check-in: Core APIs Stabilized
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body:
Good news: by 07/06 the core API surface for Project Alpha is stable in staging. We completed integration test runs for the primary endpoints (auth + metrics read + export). No new regressions after the last WebSocket gateway patch.

Remaining engineering work is limited to documentation polish and tightening alert thresholds. Engineering can support the integration acceptance checklist, but we need delivery to lock the QA window so we can staff on-call.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Project Alpha Support Concern: Post-Launch Ticket Volume Prep
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body:
We’re worried about support readiness for Project Alpha launch. Based on prior dashboards, we expect a spike in migration/help requests and incident reports during the first 72 hours.

Current gaps:
- We do not yet have the runbook for “export endpoint throttling” and “WebSocket reconnect behavior”.
- The customer-facing troubleshooting flow is not final.
- We need confirmation on the estimated rollout timing so we can ensure on-call coverage and training.

Please share: rollout schedule + the top 5 known issues with mitigations.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Project Alpha Customer Success Sync: Training & Migration Assistance
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body:
CS update: customer calls are progressing for Project Alpha, but we need an early confirmation on training + migration help.

What we told customers:
- Training sessions start the week before rollout.
- Migration assistance is included for the first two cycles.

What we still need internally:
1) confirm whether training is “recorded + live Q&A” or live-only
2) confirm the migration assistance window (days) and who provides escalation
3) align on one message for readiness: customers are hearing different timelines from different internal teams.

If we can’t align by 07/13, CS will pause new scheduling requests to avoid contradicting messaging.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Project Alpha Comms: Shared Uptime Dashboard Link
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body:
FYI for Project Alpha stakeholders: the shared uptime dashboard is https://alpha-status.mycompany.internal (requires SSO). Please use it as the single source of truth for incident monitoring during rollout.

If you see discrepancies, escalate with timestamp + service name so we can correlate. Do not base ticket volume assumptions on internal estimates alone.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Re: Project Alpha Integration Acceptance — Checklist Details
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body:
Acceptance checklist for Project Alpha integration (for QA sign-off):
- Auth handshake completes for 3 test tenants
- Metrics read returns correct counts for baseline dataset
- Export endpoint returns expected file format for 2 scenarios
- WebSocket gateway reconnect within 10s recovers stream
- Audit log entries exist for all actions above

We can run the checklist during 07/15-07/17 as long as staging remains consistent. Please ensure Engineering does not introduce schema changes during this window.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Metrics Definition Correction: Project Alpha “Success Rate” Calculation
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body:
Correction / alignment notice (important): our previously reported “Success Rate” for Project Alpha used an inconsistent metrics definition.

What changed:
- Old definition (used in earlier status emails): Success Rate = successful events / all events observed in gateway logs.
- New definition (now adopted): Success Rate = successful user sessions / total authenticated sessions (excludes failed auth).

Impact:
- The old metric will look lower in environments with auth failures.
- Engineering’s staging numbers and Support’s production ticket correlates were comparing different denominators.

Going forward:
- Use the new definition for all stakeholder reporting.
- When discussing stability, separate “API success” from “session success”.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Project Alpha Engineering Response: Follow-up on Acceptance + Metrics
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body:
Responding to the acceptance checklist and metrics correction.

1) Integration testing status: we completed endpoint verification in staging and agree the acceptance window still requires QA sign-off, per the checklist. We will not introduce schema changes during 07/15-07/17.
2) Metrics: we confirm the “Success Rate” miscomparison was due to the session vs gateway denominator. Engineering agrees to report using the new definition from 07/18 onward.

We need delivery to update the rollout narrative accordingly so Support and CS are not using conflicting numbers.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Agenda: Weekend Social — Not for Project Alpha
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body: Reminder for the weekend social. There is no Project Alpha content in this thread.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Promo: Get 30% off Analytics Pro (Limited Time)
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body: Special discount available for Analytics Pro. Unrelated to Project Alpha.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Agenda for Customer Summit — Q3 2026
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body: Schedule details for the Customer Summit. No reference to Project Alpha.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Random Thread: Deployment rotation questions
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body: Questions about deployment rotation policy. Not related to Project Alpha.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Alphaware Update: Marketing dashboard status
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body: This is about Alphaware (a different internal initiative). It should be ignored when producing Project Alpha reporting.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Project Alpha Status Alignment (Final for Leadership)
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body:
Leadership alignment — consolidated for Project Alpha.

Resolved status after the metrics definition correction (07/18):
- Engineering: core APIs are stable in staging; QA acceptance is still required but can proceed per checklist.
- Delivery: integration acceptance window is confirmed for 07/15-07/17; rollout messaging will use the corrected “Success Rate” definition.
- Support: runbooks are in draft; final top-5 issue list will be ready by 07/22; staffing coverage is being prepared pending rollout date confirmation.
- Customer Success: training and migration assistance messaging is pending leadership confirmation for content format (recorded+live vs live-only) and the escalation owner.

Proposed rollout readiness target: after QA sign-off + final support/CS enablement.

Please confirm the following items by 07/24 COB: (1) training format and escalation owner (2) definitive rollout date after QA sign-off (3) approved customer communication language referencing corrected metrics.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Project Alpha (FYI): Policy update on access controls
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body: Access control policy update for Project Alpha-related services. Please review by next week.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Re: Project Alpha Support Runbook Draft — Migration Assistance Workflow
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body:
Support runbook draft is ready for migration assistance workflow.
- Includes escalation ladder and expected response times.
- Covers “export throttling” and “WebSocket reconnect” with mitigation steps.

We still need one decision from leadership: who owns the customer escalation after the first 2 assistance cycles (Support vs CS). Once confirmed, we can finalize the customer-facing instructions.

notes.difference_summary: 在保持 Project Alpha 邮件汇总基础上，新增多角色对齐视角与“口径更正/信息冲突消解”，并用最新领导定稿邮件统一最终状态。
fixture_design_summary: 共13封：8封 Project Alpha 相关（delivery/engineering/support/customer-success/comms），4封噪声（agenda/promo/random 等），1封相似但不相关（Alphaware）。
制造至少两处分歧：工程称核心API稳定/已完成验证，但交付与QA说明仍需集成验收窗口；支持担心工单量与runbook未定稿。
包含口径更正邮件（metrics definition correction）：success rate 的分母从 gateway日志改为 session success，并要求后续统一采用新定义。
最后加入“Leadership Status Alignment (Final)”邮件，作为最新一致结论来源，确保最终 Current Status 与前文对齐。
实体与收件对象在不同邮件中保持一致的团队称谓（delivery-ops/engineering-leads/support-oncall/csm-team/leadership），便于代理按角色归纳。
